findings.description: get_help_record now returns self.help unchanged, which is None when an argument has no help text. The removed call-site fallback `or (arg.make_metavar(ctx), "")` no longer covers this, so format_help_text passes a None description to write_dl.
findings.rationale: Trigger: a command with one documented Argument and one undocumented Argument, so the guard `any(arg.help is not None ...)` passes. Mechanism: the undocumented argument yields (metavar, None), and write_dl calls text wrapping on the None description, which raises an AttributeError or TypeError. Impact: --help crashes for a common mix of documented and undocumented positional arguments, despite the docstring promising an empty description.
